subject: NVIDIA Corp (NVDA) SWOT analysis

sources.detail: Q2 FY2027 (ended 2026-07-26): revenue $96.2B, +18% QoQ, +106% YoY; non-GAAP EPS $2.22 (beat by $0.13). Data center dominant.
Market cap ~$4.31T (2nd most valuable). Trailing P/E ~39.07; forward P/E ~37 (FY2027E), ~19 (FY2028E). Sourced via FMP/macrotrends-derived snippets retrieved through the r.jina.ai reader proxy.
GAAP gross margin 75.0%, non-GAAP 75.2% (recovered from ~71-73% during Blackwell ramp).
Blackwell in volume production; Rubin 2026 (336B transistors, 50 PFLOPS NVFP4); Vera Rubin NVL144 (3.3x training/inference); Rubin Ultra H2 2027; Feynman next. Annual architecture cadence.
H20 license required Apr 2025 -> $4.5B charge (Q1 FY2026) and $2.5B unshipped revenue; H200 conditional approval Dec 2025 with 25% tariff + 50% volume cap + per-shipment licenses.
Broadcom is design partner for Google TPU, Meta MTIA, Microsoft Maia, and OpenAI custom silicon; Broadcom + Marvell ~95% of custom ASIC co-design market. AMD MI350/MI400 competing.
Big 4 + Oracle capex ~$720-745B for 2026; Amazon ~$200-220B; Microsoft raised guidance to $125-145B citing component costs; total AI infra est. $1.2-1.3T.

methodology_notes: Web search / web_extract backends were unavailable (missing firecrawl dependency), so all research used the r.jina.ai reader proxy against DuckDuckGo HTML and direct pages.

Search snippets mixed articles from Nov 2025 and Nov 2026; the revenue timeline was reconciled by cross-checking 'up X% YoY' against known historical quarters. The $57B 'up 62% YoY' figure is Q3 FY2026 (Oct 2025), NOT the current quarter; the latest reported quarter is Q2 FY2027 ($96.2B).

stockanalysis.com returned a JS/cookie wall (476 bytes); NVIDIA's news site returned a consent wall; valuation figures therefore came from aggregator snippets rather than a single authoritative page, and are labeled as approximate.
Q3 FY2027 results (expected ~Nov 18-20 2026) had not been reported as of the analysis date.
limitations: Market cap and P/E figures are point-in-time and approximate (snippet-sourced); treat as directional, not authoritative to the dollar.
Forward P/E of ~19x for FY2028 embeds consensus earnings estimates that assume continued rapid growth; the actual figure depends on earnings delivery.
This is informational analysis, not investment advice.
